review_candidates.title: Recruitment Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Recruitment Specialist to source and recruit skilled and technical personnel for infrastructure and construction projects in Ghana. The successful candidate will manage recruitment assignments from sourcing through onboarding, with a focus on construction and infrastructure roles. Candidates with strong industry networks, established recruitment resources, and experience recruiting for construction companies, contractors, engineering firms, or infrastructure projects are highly preferred. Key Recruitment Areas The role will focus on infrastructure-related positions, including: Carpenters / Formwork Carpenters Steel Fixers / Rebar Workers Masons / Bricklayers Crane Operators / Crane Drivers Excavator, Loader, and Heavy Equipment Operators Surveyors Civil Engineers / Site Engineers Construction Supervisors Safety Officers / HSE personnel Other skilled and technical construction workers Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment Delivery Manage assigned recruitment requests for infrastructure and construction positions. Develop and carry out sourcing plans to attract qualified candidates. Source candidates through professional networks, construction companies, contractors, technical institutions, social media, referrals, and recruitment agencies. Build and maintain a candidate database of skilled workers, technicians, engineers, and construction professionals. 2. Industry Talent Sourcing Build and maintain professional contacts with construction companies, contractors, engineering firms, technical schools, professional associations, and other industry sources. Develop talent pools for recurring and hard-to-fill infrastructure positions. Use relevant professional and community networks to identify suitable candidates. 3. Candidate Screening and Assessment Review applications and CVs, conduct phone interviews, and complete initial assessments. Assess candidates’ technical experience, qualifications, salary expectations, and availability. Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and keep candidates informed throughout the recruitment process. Support successful candidates through offer acceptance and onboarding. 4. Recruitment Channel Development Identify and develop new recruitment channels to strengthen candidate pipelines. Explore local recruitment resources in Accra, Kumasi, Takoradi, Cape Coast, the Eastern Region, and other major construction labor markets. Build sourcing relationships with community and labor agents, schools, employee referral networks, and online platforms. 5. Recruitment Data and Reporting Track candidates sourced, interviews, offers, hires, and onboarding progress for assigned vacancies. Prepare regular updates on recruitment progress, challenges, and support needs. Review sourcing results and recommend improvements to recruitment approaches. 6. Recruitment Team Coordination Coordinate with hiring managers, recruitment colleagues, and other HR team members to meet hiring needs. Share relevant candidate and labor-market information with the recruitment team. Contribute to consistent recruitment standards and processes for infrastructure positions. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management, Social Science or any related program. Previous recruitment or HR experience, preferably in construction, infrastructure, engineering, manufacturing, mining, or a related industry. Proven experience recruiting skilled workers, technicians, engineers, or construction professionals. Experience working in or recruiting for construction or infrastructure companies is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of Ghana’s construction and infrastructure labor market. Excellent candidate-sourcing, communication, and interviewing skills. Strong organization and coordination skills. Ability to work independently and meet recruitment targets. Good English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Candidates with the following resources or experience will be given priority: Existing talent networks within Ghana’s construction industry. Strong relationships with construction companies, contractors, or engineering firms. Access to skilled-worker communities or professional networks. Experience recruiting crane operators, heavy-equipment operators, surveyors, engineers, or other technical construction personnel will be an added advantage. Experience working with labor agencies, community recruitment networks, or technical schools. An existing candidate database or proven recruitment channels. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Number of qualified candidates sourced Number of interviews completed Number of successful hires Recruitment fulfillment rate for assigned vacancies Time-to-hire Candidate retention and onboarding completion New recruitment channels developed Size and quality of the infrastructure talent pool What We Offer Competitive salary, benefits and performance-based incentives. Career development opportunities within the HR and recruitment function

Ensure collection and organization of final technical dossiers and as-built documentation. Support definition of maintenance strategies, inspection routines, and reliability requirements for new equipment. Key Success Factors & Prerequisites: Strong ability to manage complex, multi-disciplinary engineering scopes in large industrial projects. Excellent interface management and coordination skills across multiple stakeholders. Strong problem-solving mindset with proactive risk identification and mitigation. Ability to ensure clear reporting, progress monitoring, and technical governance. Strong commitment to Health, Safety & Environmental standards. Availability for frequent coordination meetings with designers, vendors, and subcontractors (including international travel). What Are We Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Engineering ; Master’s degree is an asset. Extensive experience (10+ years) in engineering and engineering management roles within large-scale industrial or EPC/EPCM projects. Proven experience leading multidisciplinary engineering scopes and teams across full project lifecycle. Strong background in large capital projects (cement, power, oil & gas, or heavy industry). Demonstrated ability to manage complex interfaces between vendors, subcontractors, and engineering contractors. Experience in technical governance, decision-making, and ensuring compliance with project scope, cost, schedule, and quality requirements. Strong leadership in coordinating engineering deliverables and driving accountability across multiple stakeholders. Solid experience in vendor/subcontractor management, technical evaluation, and coordination during execution. Strong understanding of industrial engineering standards, safety, and regulatory frameworks. Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, large-scale international project environments with senior stakeholder exposure. The company offers: A unique opportunity to work for a leading player in the building industry and a Top Employer, recognized for its commitment to its people. Continuous training and career growth opportunities within an international Group. Opportunity to contribute to a pioneering CCS project with major environmental impact. Installer le patient dès son entrée au bloc opératoire Préparer et manipuler les instruments selon le programme opératoire Assister l’anesthésiste et les chirurgiens Participer à la gestion administrative du bloc opératoire Assurer la surveillance du patient en salle de réveil Compétences requises Tu es diplômé.e infirmier.e bachelier.e ou breveté.e Tu as une bonne gestion de tes émotions et tu es résistant.e au stress Planification et organisation te définissent assez bien Tu possèdes une connaissance approfondie des mesures d'hygiène et d'asepsie Tu sais t'adapter aux différentes procédures chirurgicales et à l'environnement variable au bloc opératoire Tu es axé.e collaboration avec l'équipe médicale et soignante pour garantir une prise en charge optimale des patients Compétences utiles La spécialisation au bloc opératoire ou expérience similaire est un atout Nous offrons Un contrat à durée indéterminée Temps de travail proposé: 100% (38h00/semaine) Tickets restaurants (valeur faciale : 5 euros) Catégorie IFIC 15 Pour les infirmiers détenteurs de la spécialisation en soins péri-opératoires, valorisation de deux ans d'ancienneté supplémentaires Une institution tournée vers le développement durable Date d'entrée en fonction : dès que possible Navette gratuite vers le site de Godinne (départ à l’arrière de la gare de Namur et place Louise Godin)
